displayName: loop-sessions: analytics export load job failed

conditions.displayName: any export load failed line in 1 h

documentation.content:
A BigQuery load job started by the hourly analytics export ended in error. The run did not advance its watermark, so nothing is lost and the next run repeats the partition; but a load that fails for a reason that does not go away (a projection column the table lacks, a permission removed from the export service account, a partition decorator on a table somebody re-created without partitioning) fails every hour and the lag alert follows.

Read the line: `gcloud logging read 'resource.type="cloud_run_job" AND resource.labels.job_name="loop-sessions-export" AND jsonPayload.message="export load failed"' --limit=10 --freshness=3h --format='value(timestamp,jsonPayload.table,jsonPayload.day,jsonPayload.job,jsonPayload.error)'`. The error is BigQuery's own (reason, message, location). `bq show -j --location=<region> <job id>` has the rest. A schema error means server/store/export_reads.go gained a column that examples/deploy-gcp/analytics/bigquery/tables.sql does not have: add it with ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS and re-run provision.sh.

Runbook: examples/deploy-gcp/README.md#runbook-export
